# opnsense_bind_acl (Data Source)

Reads a BIND ACL.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opnsense_bind_acl" "internal" {
  id = opnsense_bind_acl.internal.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the ACL.

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `name` (String)
- `networks` (Set of String)
